language.title: Choose your language
language.subtitle: You can change this later in settings.

welcome.title: Welcome to GG Predict
welcome.body: Predict football matches, compete with your friends, and climb the leaderboard.

leagues.title: Leagues you can play
leagues.body: Predict across the biggest competitions. More leagues are on the way.

groups.title: Play with friends
groups.body: Create a group and share the invite link, or join a friend's group with their code. Everyone in the group predicts the same matches.

predict.title: Make your predictions
predict.body: Before kickoff, predict the final score. When the lineups drop, tap players to pick goalscorers and cards.

scoring.title: How scoring works
scoring.body: Earn points for the right outcome, the exact score, and correct goalscorers. Each group owner can fine-tune the scoring rules.

leaderboard.title: Climb the leaderboard
leaderboard.body: Points from every match add up. Track your rank against the rest of your group in real time.
